title: Only-Alone
script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local Name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local Button1 = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- Parent
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- FRAME (Ultra-Mini, Right Hand, Rounded)
Frame.Name = "MainFrame"
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.78,0,0.45,0) -- Right Hand
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,100,0,60)
Frame.ZIndex = 2

-- Rounded Corners
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)
FrameCorner.Parent = Frame

-- TITLE
Name.Parent = Frame
Name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Name.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,14)
Name.Font = Enum.Font.Jura
Name.Text = "ئەنتی-بانگ"
Name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
Name.TextScaled = true
Name.ZIndex = 3

-- BUTTON (Centered)
Button1.Parent = Frame
Button1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
Button1.Size = UDim2.new(0,80,0,25)
Button1.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -40,0.35,0) -- Centered horizontally
Button1.Font = Enum.Font.Jura
Button1.Text = "دەست پێکردن"
Button1.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
Button1.TextScaled = true
Button1.ZIndex = 3

-- Button Rounded
ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,5)
ButtonCorner.Parent = Button1

Button1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1000
	local lastCFrame = hrp.CFrame
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0,-500,0))
	wait(0.7)
	hrp.CFrame = lastCFrame
	workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -500
end)

-- CLOSE BUTTON
CloseButton.Parent = Frame
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,0,0)
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,0)
CloseButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
CloseButton.Text = "X"
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
CloseButton.TextScaled = true
CloseButton.ZIndex = 3

-- Close Rounded
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseButton

CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Frame:Destroy()
end)

-- DRAG SYSTEM (Right Hand, Smooth)
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local DRAG_POWER = 3

local function update(input)
	local delta = (input.Position - dragStart) * DRAG_POWER
	local newPos = UDim2.new(
		startPos.X.Scale,
		startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
		startPos.Y.Scale,
		startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
	TweenService:Create(Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Position = newPos}):Play()
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Frame.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		update(input)
	end
end)
